name: Codex
description: An OpenAI Codex model-provider connection that lets Meshery interact with Codex for AI inference.

discovered.description: Registers the discovered Codex connection with Meshery and verifies connectivity to the configured endpoint.
Ignores the discovered Codex connection: Meshery takes no further action on it. You can register it again whenever you choose.

registered.description: Connects to Codex and makes its models available in Meshery.
Keeps the Codex registration but stops Meshery from connecting to or acting on it. You can register it again whenever you choose.

connected.description: Disconnects Codex: its models stop being available in Meshery. The registration is kept, so you can connect it again later.
Removes the Codex connection and its record from Meshery's database.

disconnected.description: Reconnects Codex and makes its models available in Meshery again.
Removes the Codex connection and its record from Meshery's database.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI API.

defaultModel.title: Default Model
defaultModel.description: The default model to use for inference (e.g. gpt-5-codex).

name.title: Connection Name
name.description: Optional friendly name for this Codex connection.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate with OpenAI Codex.
